profile.name: Marvin Seyfarth
profile.institute: Institute for Artificial Intelligence in Cardiovascular Medicine
profile.intro: I develop and evaluate generative models for medical imaging, with a focus on efficient 3D and 4D synthesis.

news.title: CardioDiT preprint released
news.text: Joint spatial and temporal modeling for 4D cardiac MRI synthesis with diffusion transformers.

news.title: VolDiT preprint released
news.text: Transformer-based volumetric medical image synthesis with segmentation-guided spatial control.

news.title: Rethinking diversity evaluation
news.text: Our BVM 2026 paper introduces WAD-Div, a feature-based measure of medical-image dataset diversity.

news.title: MedLoRD published online
news.text: Our SASHIMI 2025 paper examines high-resolution 3D CT synthesis under limited computational resources.

news.title: Patient-data memorization study published
news.text: Our Nature Biomedical Engineering study investigates patient-image memorization in unconditional latent diffusion models.

talks.title: From papers to models and back: how to become an AI-empowered scientist using AI agents
talks.session: How to design the flow with OpenClaw and Co: vibe coding across agencies
